info.description: The Go core's HTTP API (internal/server). Generated by tools/contract from the route table and the Go types; do not edit. Decision ids are evidence seqs; CLEARANCE_PROVIDERS registers the providers that may evaluate and record.
info.title: Clearance core

post.summary: Decide one AuthZEN access evaluation (tool.call, session.spawn, session.open, model.call) and record the decision in the evidence chain, sealed by the core. The answer carries decision_id, the record's seq, for the outcome route.

put.summary: The provider's whole set of cluster-pinned agent definitions (its Agent XR loader's pins and rejections) replaces the set the core holds. The core decides each pin itself (schema, name, owner, workload identity, not a bundled name) and records each change once as definition.load, definition.unload or definition.reject; provenance then reads the pinned definitions. Only the provider registered with definitions: true.
